                "WHERE r.node_id = %s AND r.active = true "

                "      AND r2.node_id != r.node_id "
                "      AND r2.active = true"

                (node_id,)
            )

                db.rollback()
                return False

            db.execute(
                "UPDATE replicas SET active = false WHERE node_id = %s AND active = true",
                (node_id,)
            )
            db.commit()
            return True
        except psycopg.errors.DeadlockDetected:
            db.rollback()
            continue
        except psycopg.errors.Error:
            db.rollback()
            return False
    return False
